core_values: Constitutional rights and rule of law

economic_policy.taxation: Moderate, broad-based taxation; keep rates competitive to encourage growth; targeted tax relief for small businesses and middle-income families; oppose both steep hikes and unfunded tax cuts.
spending_priorities: Balanced budget over the economic cycle
economic_policy.trade: Open, rules-based free trade through multilateral agreements; oppose both protectionism and unregulated globalisation; support fair competition.
economic_policy.regulation: Smart regulation: protect consumers and competition without burdening entrepreneurs; streamline permitting; cost-benefit review of all major rules; sunset clauses.

social_policy.healthcare: Mixed public-private healthcare; maintain a competitive insurance market with a public safety net for those who cannot afford coverage; cap out-of-pocket costs; oppose both full nationalisation and full deregulation.
social_policy.education: Increase public school quality through accountability and funding; expand access to higher education and vocational training; support charter schools with oversight; local curriculum control.
social_policy.housing: Increase housing supply through zoning reform and streamlined permitting; public-private partnerships for affordable housing; oppose heavy-handed rent controls; support first-time buyer incentives.
social_policy.civil_rights: Protect all constitutional rights equally; anti-discrimination protections based on individual merit; defend free speech and religious freedom; pragmatic immigration reform balancing economic needs with orderly borders.
social_policy.immigration: Orderly, managed immigration tied to economic needs; streamlined legal pathways; secure but humane borders; integration support for new residents; oppose both open borders and mass deportation.

governance.decentralization: Strong national framework with local implementation flexibility; empower municipalities on planning and services; oppose both over-centralisation and fragmentation.
governance.transparency: Full disclosure of government spending and lobbying; strengthen freedom-of-information laws; independent anti-corruption watchdogs.
governance.electoral_reform: Independent redistricting commissions; consider ranked-choice voting; automatic voter registration; reasonable campaign finance limits; protect election integrity.

environment.climate_action: Technology-neutral approach to emissions reduction; market-based mechanisms like modest carbon pricing; invest in R&D for clean energy and carbon capture; meet climate goals without crushing industry.
environment.energy: All-of-the-above energy strategy: renewables, nuclear, natural gas as bridge fuel; phase out coal gradually; energy security through diversification, not mandates.
environment.conservation: Evidence-based conservation; balance environmental protection with economic use; expand national parks and green spaces; invest in clean water and air quality.

security.defense: Maintain strong, professional defence forces; invest in modern capabilities; alliance-based security through NATO and partners; defence spending at credible levels.
security.law_enforcement: Well-funded, professional policing with accountability; community engagement; evidence-based criminal justice reform; tough on violent crime, smart on rehabilitation.
security.foreign_policy: Rules-based international order; strong alliances; promote democracy and trade abroad; strategic foreign aid; engage diplomatically before resorting to force.
